name: bishop_of_wings_an_angel_token_dying_counts_through_last_known_information
notes: Printed: 'Whenever an Angel you control dies, create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying.' An Angel TOKEN of seat 0 dies and ceases to exist (CR 704.5d), yet the trigger that names it still happens: it is read as it last existed (an Angel seat 0 controlled), so exactly one Spirit exists and no Angel token does.
